package answer

import "strings"

const (
	taskEvaluationAuto   = "AUTO"
	taskEvaluationManual = "MANUAL"
	taskEvaluationHybrid = "HYBRID"

	taskSubmissionSnapshot      = "SNAPSHOT"
	taskSubmissionAnswerPayload = "ANSWER_PAYLOAD"
)

func NormalizeTaskMetadata(meta *TaskMetadata) *TaskMetadata {
	if meta == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(meta.TaskKind) == "" {
		meta.TaskKind = taskKindFromType(meta.Type)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(meta.TaskKind) == "" {
		meta.TaskKind = inferTaskKind(meta.CodeStructureType)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(meta.ExecutionMode) == "" {
		meta.ExecutionMode = inferExecutionMode(meta.CodeStructureType, meta.TaskKind)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(meta.EvaluationMode) == "" {
		meta.EvaluationMode = inferEvaluationMode(meta.CodeStructureType, meta.TaskKind)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(meta.UIMode) == "" {
		meta.UIMode = inferUIMode(meta.TaskKind)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(meta.SubmissionMode) == "" {
		meta.SubmissionMode = inferSubmissionMode(meta.TaskKind)
	}
	if !meta.RequiresSandbox && strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(meta.ExecutionMode)) != "NO_RUN" {
		meta.RequiresSandbox = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(meta.SubmissionMode)) == taskSubmissionSnapshot
	}
	if !meta.ExposesPreview {
		meta.ExposesPreview = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(meta.UIMode)) == "PREVIEW"
	}
	if !meta.ExposesTerminal {
		meta.ExposesTerminal = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(meta.UIMode)) == "TERMINAL"
	}
	if !meta.SupportsLiveValidation && meta.RequiresSandbox {
		meta.SupportsLiveValidation = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(meta.EvaluationMode)) != taskEvaluationManual
	}
	if strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(meta.ExecutionMode)) == "NO_RUN" {
		meta.RequiresSandbox = false
		meta.ExposesPreview = false
		meta.ExposesTerminal = false
		meta.SupportsLiveValidation = false
	}
	return meta
}

func taskKindFromType(taskType int16) string {
	switch taskType {
	case 1:
		return "frontend_preview"
	case 2:
		return "fullstack_page"
	case 3:
		return "cli_programming"
	case 4:
		return "api_endpoint"
	case 5:
		return "debug_fix"
	case 6:
		return "refactor_quality"
	case 7:
		return "git_cli"
	case 8:
		return "sql_query"
	case 9:
		return "quiz_theory"
	case 10:
		return "practice_task_milestone"
	case 11:
		return "test"
	case 12:
		return "ordering"
	case 13:
		return "classification"
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

func inferTaskKind(code string) string {
	switch strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(code)) {
	case "HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT", "CSS_BASIC_STYLESHEET", "REACT_COMPONENT_BASIC":
		return "frontend_preview"
	case "PHP_BASIC_SCRIPT", "NEXTJS_BASIC":
		return "fullstack_page"
	case "EXPRESSJS_BASIC":
		return "api_endpoint"
	case "JAVASCRIPT_BASIC", "JAVASCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT", "TYPESCRIPT_BASIC", "TYPESCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT", "NODEJS_BASIC_SCRIPT":
		return "cli_programming"
	case "QUIZ_TEXT_BASIC":
		return "quiz_theory"
	case "TEST_SINGLE_CHOICE_BASIC":
		return "test"
	case "TEST_ORDERING_BASIC":
		return "ordering"
	case "TEST_CLASSIFICATION_BASIC":
		return "classification"
	default:
		return "frontend_preview"
	}
}

func inferExecutionMode(code, kind string) string {
	switch kind {
	case "quiz_theory", "test", "ordering", "classification":
		return "NO_RUN"
	case "api_endpoint":
		return "HTTP_API"
	case "cli_programming", "git_cli", "sql_query", "debug_fix", "refactor_quality":
		return "TERMINAL_RUN"
	default:
		switch strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(code)) {
		case "JAVASCRIPT_BASIC", "JAVASCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT", "TYPESCRIPT_BASIC", "TYPESCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT", "NODEJS_BASIC_SCRIPT":
			return "TERMINAL_RUN"
		case "EXPRESSJS_BASIC":
			return "HTTP_API"
		default:
			return "BROWSER_PREVIEW"
		}
	}
}

func inferEvaluationMode(code, kind string) string {
	switch kind {
	case "api_endpoint", "refactor_quality":
		return taskEvaluationHybrid
	case "quiz_theory", "test", "ordering", "classification", "frontend_preview", "cli_programming", "debug_fix":
		return taskEvaluationAuto
	case "fullstack_page", "git_cli", "sql_query", "practice_task_milestone":
		return taskEvaluationManual
	}

	switch strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(code)) {
	case "EXPRESSJS_BASIC":
		return taskEvaluationHybrid
	case "NEXTJS_BASIC":
		return taskEvaluationManual
	default:
		return taskEvaluationAuto
	}
}

func inferUIMode(kind string) string {
	switch kind {
	case "quiz_theory", "test", "ordering", "classification":
		return "QUIZ"
	case "api_endpoint", "debug_fix", "refactor_quality":
		return "REPORT"
	case "cli_programming", "git_cli", "sql_query":
		return "TERMINAL"
	default:
		return "PREVIEW"
	}
}

func inferSubmissionMode(kind string) string {
	if kind == "quiz_theory" || kind == "test" || kind == "ordering" || kind == "classification" {
		return taskSubmissionAnswerPayload
	}
	return taskSubmissionSnapshot
}
